sections.text: Before starting the pump, the following steps should be checked

items:
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting; it 
 is clockwise .

The check must be carried out be qualified and competent 
 operators , starting the motor for a few second.
Filling the pump casing with the liquid.
Fill suction line with liquid and completely prime pump.
Turn Rotation Element By Hand To Make Sure It Rotates Freely.
Tighten plugs in gauge and drain taps.

Check suction and discharge piping for leaks , and make sure for 
 flange bolts are securely tighten need .

sections.text:
Attendance 
and checking during operation of the pump, the following should be checked

items: Check of flow rate and delivery head.
Check the shaft seal for leaks.

Check that the current absorbed by the motor does not exceed 
 the rated value shown on the name plate.
Check the pump pressure.
Install coupling guard on flexible coupled unit.

Fully open gate valve (if any ) in suction line , and close 
 gate valve in discharge line.
Check discharge piping for pressure leaks.
Check vibration .

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, 
 which must be performed on yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title 
 block.
This 
 pump is used to plant service for piping flushing, chemical dilution and 
 general uses.
Technical Specification:
Number of Stages | 1
Speed | 2900 RPM
Power Consumed | 2.45 KW
Liquid Handled | Filtrated Water
Capacity | 20 M/H
Head | 30 M

Starting the Pump
Before starting the pump, the following steps should be checked
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting; it 
 is clockwise .
The check must be carried out be qualified and competent

Filling the pump casing with the liquid.
Fill suction line with liquid and completely prime pump.
Turn Rotation Element By Hand To Make Sure It Rotates Freely.
Tighten plugs in gauge and drain taps.
Check suction and discharge piping for leaks , and make sure for

Install coupling guard on flexible coupled unit.
